class.name: CgameTaskGraph
class.brief_description: Dependency-aware task graph executed on the [WorkerThreadPool].
class.description: [CgameTaskGraph] schedules named tasks with dependency edges. [method run] executes the graph in deterministic waves: each wave contains every pending task whose dependencies are done, pooled tasks of a wave run in parallel on the [WorkerThreadPool], and tasks added with [code]thread_safe = false[/code] run on the calling thread while the rest of the wave executes. A task fails when its callable returns [code]false[/code], returns a [Dictionary] with an [code]"error"[/code] key, or cannot be called. A failed task cancels all of its transitive dependants; independent branches still run. Per-task timing feeds [method critical_path] and [method to_dot]. When [CgameTrace] is enabled, each task appears as a scope and dependencies are drawn as flow arrows. [codeblock] var graph := CgameTaskGraph.new() graph.add_task("load", load_assets) graph.add_task("build", build_world, PackedStringArray(["load"])) var report := graph.run() [/codeblock]

method.name: add_dependency
method.description: Adds an extra dependency edge. Returns [code]false[/code] if either task is unknown or the edge would create a cycle.

method.name: add_task
method.description: Registers a task and returns its name, or an empty string if the name is empty or duplicate or the dependencies would form a cycle (the task is not added then). Dependencies may name tasks that are added later; [method validate] reports names that never appear.

method.name: critical_path
method.description: Returns the longest dependency chain by measured duration. Tasks that have not run count as 1 ms.

method.name: critical_path_ms
method.description: Returns the summed duration of [method critical_path] in milliseconds.

method.name: error_of
method.description: Returns the failure message of a task, or an empty string.

method.name: get_last_total_ms
method.description: Returns the wall time of the last [method run] in milliseconds.

method.name: get_task_names
method.description: Returns all task names in insertion order.

method.name: get_wave_count
method.description: Returns the number of waves of the last [method run].

method.name: has_task
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a task with this name exists.

method.name: result_of
method.description: Returns the value returned by the task callable, or [code]null[/code].

method.name: results
method.description: Returns all results keyed by task name, inserted in topological order.

method.name: run
method.description: Executes the graph and returns [code]{ok, order, failed, cancelled, waves, total_ms, error}[/code]. Returns [code]ok = false[/code] with an [code]error[/code] message when a dependency is unknown or a cycle exists.

method.name: state_of
method.description: Returns a [enum TaskState] value, or [code]-1[/code] for unknown tasks.

method.name: timing
method.description: Returns [code]{start_us, end_us, duration_ms, wave, thread_id, thread_safe}[/code] for a task, or an empty dictionary if it is unknown.

method.name: to_dot
method.description: Returns the graph in Graphviz DOT format. Critical path nodes and edges are red, failed tasks are filled, cancelled tasks are dashed.

method.name: topological_order
method.description: Returns a deterministic topological order (ties broken by insertion order).

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns one message per dependency that names an unknown task.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], task scopes and dependency flows are recorded in [CgameTrace] while it is enabled.

constants.constant: The task was skipped because a dependency failed or was cancelled.
